title: DevOps Easy Learning quiz bank (owner 2026-11-28)
description: A lesson's quiz (lesson folder / quiz.json) or an assessment (<assessments>/module-<n>-assessment.json, final-assessment.json, scenario-<name>.json). Questions only from the course's own content. Counts follow docs/COURSE_STANDARD.md §8a (by video length: <5 min 3–5, 5–10 5–8, 10–20 8–12, 20–30 10–15, 30–45 15–20, 45–60 20–25, >60 25–30+; module assessment 15–30, final 30–60). The publisher checks it (tools/mcp-server/src/quizfile.ts) and the API checks it again.

title.description: Assessments: the lesson title shown (default 'Module <n> assessment', 'Final assessment', 'Scenario: <name>').

section.description: Scenario assessments: the module (1-based) it closes; default the last.

kind.description: Set by the publisher from the file name for assessments.

scenario.description: The situation shown above the questions (scenario assessments).

sampleSize.description: Questions drawn per attempt from the bank.

pool.description: Also draw from the lesson quizzes of this module or of the whole course.

id.description: Stable id (keep it when editing the question, so results stay linked).

correct.description: Index of the right option (0 = the first).

why.description: Why the right answer is right.

explanations.description: One per option, same order: why it is right or wrong.

takeaway.description: The lesson or best practice to remember.

type.description: The last two are accepted names for code and scenario.

topic.description: Used for the per-topic score summary.

timestamp.description: Seconds into the lesson video where this is taught ('Watch this part').

code.description: A snippet shown with the question (config, command output, code).

fixedOrder.description: Keep the options in this order (e.g. 'all of the above').
